title: Stardust (Nat King Cole)
lyrics_synced:
[00:06.29] And now the purple dusk of twilight time
[00:11.74] Steals across the meadows of my heart
[00:17.98] High up in the sky the little stars climb
[00:23.41] Always reminding me that we're apart
[00:29.67] You wander down the lane and far away
[00:35.18] Leaving me a song that will not die
[00:41.40] Love is now the stardust of yesterday
[00:47.23] The music of the years gone by
[00:51.64] Sometimes I wonder why I spend
[00:56.37] The lonely night dreaming of a song
[01:04.81] The melody haunts my reverie
[01:10.68] And I am once again with you
[01:15.40] When our love was new
[01:19.79] And each kiss an inspiration
[01:27.09] But that was long ago
[01:30.41] Now my consolation
[01:34.14] Is in the stardust of a song
[02:25.66] Beside a garden wall
[02:30.01] When stars are bright
[02:35.16] You are in my arms
[02:38.50] The nightingale tells his fairy tale
[02:44.30] A paradise where roses bloom
[02:49.05] Though I dream in vain
[02:54.17] In my heart it will remain
[03:00.77] My stardust melody
[03:04.80] The memory of love's refrain
